Daily Devotional

July 22

7 That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life. 8 This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men. (Titus 3:7-8 KJV)

To be an heir with Christ we have to first be justified by His grace. No justification means no being heirs with Him. It all depends upon our having faith in the grace (Ephesians 2:8) that Jesus brought to us, making us not only heirs with Him, but giving us all that Jesus is, as we get His spirit in us, and He lives within us (Galatians 4:6).

Paul is telling us that we, as Christians, need to live a life that will reflect all the good qualities that Jesus has and we need to live holy as He is holy (1 Peter 1:16). Our light needs to shine at all times (Matthew 5:16), so that the life we live will be a good testimony for Christ. The trouble is that most Christians live a life that does not reflect the qualities that Jesus has, and if they were ever arrested and tried for being a Christian, there would not be enough evidence to convict them. That should not be so, as we are the salt of the earth (Matthew 5:13), and we need to get out of the shaker and represent our Savior to others, so that the Kingdom of God can be populated here on earth. Let your light shine for Jesus.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
